item.title: Running a 68060 CPU in Quadra 650
item.description:
📝 68060 in Macintosh Quadra 650 This project is a collection of ROM modifications to get a minimum level of functionality out of a Macintosh Quadra 650/800 / Centris 650 with a 68060 installed on an appropriate adapter. Please don't rush out to replicate this unless you know exactly what you're getting into, or you will be disappointed. Do with it what you will.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/ZigZagJoe/Macintosh-Q650-68060
